paras.en: (2) Company A requires a block of 1000 IPv4 addresses. To avoid over-allocating a subnet significantly larger than their needs, what should be the length of the network portion for the assigned subnet? Briefly explain your answer.
paras.zh: (2) 公司 A 需要一个含 1000 个 IPv4 地址的地址块。为了不分配比需要大得多的子网，分给它的子网的网络部分应该有多长？简要解释。

items.en: **Subnetting**: splitting one network's block of addresses into smaller parts. Built up below, with what it is for.
items.zh: **子网划分**：把一个网络的地址块切成几个更小的部分。下面从头讲，连同它的用处。

items.en: **A block of 1000 IPv4 addresses**: addresses are handed out in blocks, never one by one. A block's size is always a power of 2, as below.
items.zh: **含 1000 个 IPv4 地址的地址块**：地址是成块分配的，从不一个一个地给。块的大小总是 2 的幂，下面会看到为什么。

items.en: **The length of the network portion**: the number of leading bits shared by every address in the block, the **prefix length**, written /n.
items.zh: **网络部分的长度**：块内所有地址共有的前面那几位的位数，即**前缀长度**，写作 /n。

items.en: **Over-allocating ... significantly larger**: choose the smallest block that still holds 1000 addresses.
items.zh: **分配……大得多的**：要选仍然装得下 1000 个地址的最小的块。

chapter.zh: 第 8 题：子网和块的大小

title.en: Network and host, prefix and mask
title.zh: 网络和主机，前缀和掩码

text.en: An IPv4 address is 32 bits, written as four bytes in decimal: **128.18.3.11**. It has two parts. The **network portion**, the leading bits, says which network the address belongs to; the **host portion**, the rest, picks one host on that network. Routers far away look only at the network portion.
text.zh: IPv4 地址有 32 位，写成四个十进制的字节：**128.18.3.11**。它分两部分。前面的**网络部分**说明地址属于哪个网络；后面的**主机部分**在这个网络里挑出一台主机。远处的路由器只看网络部分。

text.en: Addresses are given out in **blocks**: every address in a block has the same network portion, and the host portion runs through every value. A block is named by its **prefix**, the lowest address and the number of network bits: **128.18.3.0/24** is the 256 addresses from 128.18.3.0 to 128.18.3.255. A /n block leaves $32 - n$ host bits, so it holds $2^{32 - n}$ addresses: each bit taken off the prefix doubles the block.
text.zh: 地址是**成块**分配的：一个块里所有地址的网络部分都相同，主机部分取遍所有值。一个块用它的**前缀**来称呼，即最低的地址加上网络位数：**128.18.3.0/24** 就是从 128.18.3.0 到 128.18.3.255 的 256 个地址。/n 的块留下 $32 - n$ 位主机位，所以有 $2^{32 - n}$ 个地址：前缀每少一位，块就大一倍。

alt.en: 32 bit boxes in four bytes: the first 22 in blue, the network portion; the last 10 in green, the host portion, 2^10 = 1024 addresses; the mask is 255.255.252.0.
alt.zh: 32 个位格分成四个字节：前 22 个蓝色，是网络部分；后 10 个绿色，是主机部分，2^10 = 1024 个地址；掩码是 255.255.252.0。

caption.en: A /22 block: 22 network bits, the same in every address of the block; 10 host bits, which take all 1024 values.
caption.zh: 一个 /22 的块：22 位网络位，块内所有地址都一样；10 位主机位，取遍全部 1024 个值。

text.en: The **subnet mask** writes the prefix as an address: 1s over the network portion, 0s over the host portion. A bitwise AND of an address with the mask keeps the network portion and clears the host bits; that is how a router extracts the network from an address.
text.zh: **子网掩码**把前缀写成地址的样子：网络部分全是 1，主机部分全是 0。地址和掩码按位与（AND），就留下网络部分、清掉主机位；路由器就是这样从地址里取出网络的。

title.en: Subnetting, and what it is for
title.zh: 子网划分，以及它的用处

text.en: The course's definition: subnetting splits a network into several parts for internal purposes, while it acts like a single network for external users. The course's example is the University of Melbourne, whose ISP gives it one prefix, 128.208.0.0/16. Inside, the university splits it: one part for Electrical Engineering (a /18), one for Arts (a /19), one for Computer Science (a /17), and the rest kept free.
text.zh: 课上的定义：子网划分把一个网络切成几部分供内部使用，而对外仍然像一个网络。课上的例子是墨尔本大学：ISP 给了它一个前缀 128.208.0.0/16。在校内，学校把它切开：一部分给电子工程（一个 /18），一部分给文学院（一个 /19），一部分给计算机系（一个 /17），剩下的留着。

text.en: Two purposes follow. **Inside**, the organisation can arrange and manage its own addresses: each department gets a subnet, and the subnets can change without asking the ISP. **Outside**, every router still needs only **one entry**, 128.208.0.0/16, for the whole university, not one per department or per host. Multiplied over every network on the Internet, that keeps routing tables from exploding; only the university's own router needs to know the subnets.
text.zh: 由此有两个目的。**对内**，机构可以自己安排和管理地址：每个系一个子网，子网怎么改都不用找 ISP。**对外**，所有路由器仍然只需要为整个大学存**一条**表项，128.208.0.0/16，而不是每个系、每台主机一条。乘上互联网上所有的网络，这就避免了路由表的爆炸；只有学校自己的路由器需要知道各个子网。

title.zh: 第 (2) 问：给 1000 个地址分块

say.en: A block's size is a power of 2. 9 host bits give 512 addresses: too few.
say.zh: 块的大小是 2 的幂。9 位主机位只有 512 个地址：不够。

say.en: 10 host bits give 1024: the smallest block that holds 1000.
say.zh: 10 位主机位有 1024 个：装得下 1000 的最小的块。

say.en: The network portion is what is left of the 32 bits.
say.zh: 网络部分就是 32 位里剩下的。

say.en: The prefix length, and the same block written as a mask.
say.zh: 前缀长度，以及同一个块的掩码写法。

outro.en: **Answer:** /22. Only 24 addresses go unused; a /21 would hand out 2048, twice what is needed. (In practice a subnet also loses its first and last address to the network itself and to broadcast, leaving 1022 for hosts: still enough.)
outro.zh: **答案：**/22。只空出 24 个地址；/21 会给 2048 个，是需要的两倍。（实际中子网的第一个和最后一个地址要留给网络本身和广播，剩 1022 个给主机：仍然够用。）

prompt.en: 10 host bits out of 32. How long is the network portion?
prompt.zh: 32 位里 10 位是主机位。网络部分有多长？

text.en: Part (1): what subnetting is (one block split inside, one network outside), then the two purposes, each with its reason. Part (2): the rule (the smallest power of 2 that holds 1000), the numbers, the prefix.
text.zh: 第 (1) 问：子网划分是什么（对内切开一个块，对外是一个网络），再写两个目的，各带理由。第 (2) 问：规则（装得下 1000 的最小的 2 的幂）、数字、前缀。

title.en: Practice exam, Q8 · a full-mark answer
title.zh: 模拟卷第 8 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: (1) Subnetting splits one network (one address block) into several parts for internal use, for example one per department, while it still appears as a single network to the outside. The organisation can manage and change its subnets internally without involving its ISP, and external routers need only one routing table entry for the whole network rather than one per subnet or host, which avoids routing table explosion.
paras.zh: (1) 子网划分把一个网络（一个地址块）切成几部分供内部使用，例如每个部门一个，而对外仍表现为一个网络。机构可以在内部管理和调整子网，无需 ISP 参与；外部路由器只需要为整个网络存一条路由表项，而不是每个子网或每台主机一条，从而避免路由表爆炸。

paras.en: (2) 22 bits (a /22 prefix). The company needs 1000 addresses, and the smallest power of 2 that holds them is 2^10 = 1024 (2^9 = 512 is too small). So the host portion needs 10 bits and the network portion is 32 − 10 = 22 bits.
paras.zh: (2) 22 位（/22 前缀）。公司需要 1000 个地址，装得下它们的最小的 2 的幂是 2^10 = 1024（2^9 = 512 不够）。所以主机部分需要 10 位，网络部分是 32 − 10 = 22 位。

paras.en: A router has built the following routing table. The router can directly deliver packets over Interface 0 and Interface 1, or it can forward to routers R2, R3 and R4.
paras.zh: 一台路由器建立了下面这张路由表。它可以经由 Interface 0 和 Interface 1 直接投递分组，也可以转发给路由器 R2、R3 和 R4。

paras.en: Describe what the router does if a packet addressed to each of the following destinations is received. (1) 148.96.40.12 (2) 196.4.153.50
paras.zh: 说明路由器收到目的地址分别为以下地址的分组时会怎么做。(1) 148.96.40.12 (2) 196.4.153.50

items.en: **Start** is the network address of each row, and **Subnet Mask** its mask: together, a prefix. The masks here are /24 (255.255.255.0), /25 (.128) and /26 (.192).
items.zh: **Start** 是每一行的网络地址，**Subnet Mask** 是它的掩码：两者合起来就是一个前缀。这里的掩码是 /24（255.255.255.0）、/25（.128）和 /26（.192）。

items.en: **Next Hop**: an **interface** means the destination is on a network attached directly to the router, so it delivers the packet itself. **R2, R3, R4** are neighbouring routers to pass the packet to. **default** is the row used when no other row matches.
items.zh: **Next Hop**（下一跳）：**接口**表示目的主机在直接连着路由器的网络上，路由器自己投递。**R2、R3、R4** 是要把分组交给的相邻路由器。**default**（默认）是其他行都不匹配时用的那一行。

items.en: **Describe what the router does**: for each address, say which row matches and the action: deliver directly over an interface, or forward to a router.
items.zh: **说明路由器会怎么做**：对每个地址，说出哪一行匹配，以及动作：从接口直接投递，还是转发给哪台路由器。

title.en: How a router matches a row

text.en: For each row, the router ANDs the destination with the row's mask and compares the result with the row's Start. Equal means the destination lies inside that row's block. Two more rules:
text.zh: 对每一行，路由器把目的地址和该行的掩码按位与，再和该行的 Start 比较。相等，就说明目的地址落在这一行的块里。还有两条规则：

items.en: **Longest prefix match**: if several rows match, the row with the longest mask wins, the smallest and most specific block.
items.zh: **最长前缀匹配**：如果有好几行都匹配，掩码最长的那一行胜出，也就是最小、最具体的那个块。

items.en: **Default**: if no row matches, the packet goes to the default route.
items.zh: **默认路由**：一行都不匹配，分组就走默认路由。

text.en: Only the bytes where the mask is not 255 need any work. A mask byte of 128 keeps the top bit of the address byte; 192 keeps the top two bits.
text.zh: 只有掩码不是 255 的那些字节需要动手算。掩码字节 128 保留地址字节的最高一位；192 保留最高两位。

title.en: When rows overlap: the longest prefix

text.en: Rows 1 and 2 of the question overlap: 148.96.39.0/24 is the whole of 148.96.39.x, and 148.96.39.128/25 is its upper half. An address such as **148.96.39.200** matches both. The longest prefix wins, so it goes out of **Interface 1**. **148.96.39.5** matches row 1 only: Interface 0. An address that matches nothing, such as 8.8.8.8, takes the default route to R4.
text.zh: 题目表里第 1 行和第 2 行是重叠的：148.96.39.0/24 是整个 148.96.39.x，148.96.39.128/25 是它的上半部分。像 **148.96.39.200** 这样的地址两行都匹配。最长前缀胜出，所以它从 **Interface 1** 出去。**148.96.39.5** 只匹配第 1 行：Interface 0。什么都不匹配的地址，比如 8.8.8.8，走默认路由去 R4。

text.en: Overlapping rows are deliberate. **CIDR** (classless inter-domain routing) lets a router **aggregate** many prefixes into one larger prefix, which keeps backbone tables small, and longest prefix match lets an exception sit inside it. The course's example: one row sends 192.24.0.0/19 (8192 addresses) towards London, and a second row sends the part 192.24.12.0/22 to San Francisco. A destination in 192.24.12.x matches both and goes to San Francisco; the rest of the /19 goes to London.
text.zh: 重叠是故意的。**CIDR**（无类域间路由）让路由器把很多前缀**聚合**成一个更大的前缀，骨干路由器的表就小了；而最长前缀匹配允许在大块里放一个例外。课上的例子：一行把 192.24.0.0/19（8192 个地址）送往伦敦，另一行把其中的 192.24.12.0/22 送往旧金山。目的地址在 192.24.12.x 里的，两行都匹配，去旧金山；/19 的其余部分去伦敦。
